scope: Compare the new two-surface annual-observation comparator with the existing NOAA raw-table reader and evidence-update snapshot comparator. Determine whether either incumbent covers the new task's valuable use case and whether any existing use remains.

matched_real_task.observation: The live page and raw table both returned 2023–2025. All three annual-growth values and uncertainties matched exactly in this capture; no difference or missing year was reported.

current_live_page_and_table_observation.disposition: CURRENT_CAPTURE_MATCHES_EXACTLY; reason for historical difference remains unknown

functional_comparison.valuable_scope: One fixed raw-table GET and a year-bounded NOAA CO2 values receipt.
functional_comparison.does_not_cover: The rendered page surface or a matched page-to-raw comparison.
functional_comparison.measured_difference: One GET versus two fixed GETs for the new cross-surface task. Timing, monetary cost, and general reliability advantage are unmeasured.

functional_comparison.valuable_scope: Structural predecessor-to-successor evidence-state and source-family deltas over time.
functional_comparison.does_not_cover: Retrieval and numeric comparison of two simultaneous provider surfaces for one annual series.

c1_disposition.basis: The new tool detects exact provider-surface value or uncertainty differences for a selected year range. The raw reader retains its lower-request-count raw-only task, and the evidence snapshot comparator retains its temporal record-delta task. No existing tool covers every valuable use of the new cross-surface task, and no existing tool is proposed for retirement.
uncertainties: A single live retrieval does not establish long-term parser reliability or provider change frequency.
The historical 2023 page/raw difference is not explained by this comparison.
Monetary/network cost beyond the fixed two-request count remains unknown.
